scope: General startup operating needs and explicitly conditional business models. The full non-chain canonical catalog crossed with the process country selector is the discovery denominator. An authored local scenario establishes instructions only for its recorded facts; unresolved entities, subnational locations, sectors and cross-border variants remain unknown.

metricDefinitions.inventoryCrosscheck: Needs explicitly compared against an external reference structure. Unchecked needs remain pending; source crosschecking is separate from independent human review.
metricDefinitions.mappedNeeds: A canonical guide is linked; this measures entry points only.
metricDefinitions.localMaterial: An authored country note, step resolution or US-scoped baseline exists; this does not establish completeness or freshness.
metricDefinitions.reviewedProcedures: All required instruction sections, sources, dates, ownership, qualified independent review and fictional scope tests are current for the stated facts.
metricDefinitions.observedProcedures: A dated independent passed-run attestation identifies this exact procedure content. Public attestation links must be verified by the contributor; case-specific authorization remains separate.
metricDefinitions.declaredScopeCompleteness: Requires independent current review of the scenario inventory and all its required procedures. Credit applies only to the stated scope; no cell is excluded for missing or not-applicable notes.

assessments.title: Run payroll for the scoped domestic company

assessments.title: Register for sales tax, VAT or GST for the scoped domestic company

assessments.title: File the recurring company registry return for the scoped domestic company

assessments.title: File the company income tax return for the scoped domestic company

assessments.title: Prepare and file statutory annual accounts for the scoped domestic company
exclusions: Dormancy, consolidated accounts, charities, regulated accounts and unresolved audit eligibility are not assessed.
